Package org.apache.beam.runners.twister2

Class Twister2RunnerRegistrar

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.runners.twister2.Twister2RunnerRegistrar
public class Twister2RunnerRegistrar extends Object
AutoService registrar - will register Twister2Runner and Twister2Options as possible pipeline runner services.

It ends up in META-INF/services and gets picked up by Beam.
